nodes.description: RhoA-GTP is two- to three-fold below control in patient B and T lymphocytes. This is the hub of the entry: RhoA activation is what the ARHGEF1 lesion removes, and both downstream arms - cortical actin assembly and ROCK-mediated restraint of PI3K/AKT - branch from here. Both are correctable, in patient cells, by a pharmacological RhoA activator or by re-expressing ARHGEF1, which is what establishes the causal direction rather than mere association.
